common_observations.description: Original Figure 5 training/validation data and matched causal spike input; evaluation behavioral truth is operator-held. Any AutoLFADS-derived trajectory library provided in common must be source-pinned and disclosed in both assistance conditions; it is not raw-data-only access.

target.description: Original Figure 5 prediction of all 15 source behavioral groups from simultaneous neural spikes over Area2_Bump, MC_Cycle, MC_Maze and MC_RTT. Reproduction covers original source-eligible method/run outputs; candidate improvement uses identical behavioral targets and information boundaries against the strongest relevant author comparator. Other paper families remain separate.

dataset.description: The four original Figure 5 datasets are Area2_Bump, MC_Cycle, MC_Maze and MC_RTT. Paper-cited DANDI versions and MC_Cycle Zenodo route are retained in source SCOPE.json. Immutable original payload equivalence and trajectory-library provenance are unbound; other paper datasets and newly generated simulations cannot substitute.

cohort.description: Table 2 reports Area2_Bump 65 neurons/364 trials; MC_Cycle 112/273; MC_Maze 182/2295; MC_RTT 130/1080. Retain all 15 group definitions and source method eligibility. Original unit/trial identities, animal/session joins and scored-row masks are not authenticated by these counts.

split.description: Original Table 4 train/test counts are Area2_Bump 272/92, MC_Cycle 174/99, MC_Maze 1721/574 and MC_RTT 810/268. MC_RTT excludes the first two of 270 candidate test segments for common history. Recover original trial order, membership and training-only validation folds; do not use NLB splits or a newly easier split.

inputs.description: All candidates and author baselines receive the same permitted training data and causal trailing spike observations with 20-ms bins. Source MINT histories are 240/200/300/480 ms for Area2_Bump/MC_Cycle/MC_Maze/MC_RTT. Future neural observations and final-test behavioral labels are unavailable to candidate fitting. Acausal factorial cells remain separate.

preprocessing.description: Preserve Tables 3–4 dataset-specific alignments, smoothing, trajectory averaging/dimensionality and evaluation epochs. Authenticate MC_RTT behavioral AutoLFADS libraries, MC_Cycle phase units/period/branch cut and original 5-ms phase aggregation. A basic three-dataset MATLAB example does not prove the complete source recipe.

metric.description: Evaluate original 5-ms behavior R2, 1 minus summed squared prediction error divided by summed squared deviations about the original target mean, with circular distances and circular mean for MC_Cycle phase. Insufficient-history masks and original eligible samples must match. Do not substitute Pearson correlation, MAE, linear phase R2 or an invented pooled scalar.

aggregation.description: Average per-dimension R2 within each source behavioral group and groups within each dataset, retaining all 15 groups and per-dimension outputs. Original feedforward/GRU results average ten initializations. Preserve source method eligibility, all original method/run bundles and undefined cases; no invented overall scalar or averaging over a favorable subset.

Algorithm-bearing author-derived inputs are disclosed common assistance, never silently raw data.
